name: Rust

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - "main"
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - "main"

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2

      - name: Build (no features enabled)
        run: cargo build --verbose

      - name: Build (all features enabled)
        run: cargo build --verbose --all-features

  formatting:
    name: Formatting
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2

      - name: Install rustfmt
        run: rustup component add rustfmt

      - name: Rustfmt
        run: cargo fmt --check

  clippy:
    name: Clippy
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2

      - name: Install Clippy
        run: rustup component add clippy

      - name: Clippy (no features enabled)
        run: cargo clippy -- -D warnings

      - name: Clippy (all features enabled)
        run: cargo clippy --all-features -- -D warnings

  test:
    name: Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2

      - name: Test (no features enabled)
        run: |
          eval `ssh-agent`
          cargo test --verbose
        env:
          RUST_BACKTRACE: 1

      - name: Test (all features enabled)
        run: |
          eval `ssh-agent`
          cargo test --verbose --all-features
        env:
          RUST_BACKTRACE: 1

[package]
name = "bitwarden-russh"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"

# See more keys and their definitions at https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/reference/manifest.html

[dependencies]
anyhow = "1.0.86"
byteorder = "1.5.0"
ecdsa = { version = "0.16.9", features = ["verifying"] }
ed25519-dalek = { version = "2.1.1", features = ["signature"] }
futures = "0.3.30"
p256 = "0.13.2"
p384 = "0.13.1"
p521 = "0.13.3"
rsa = "0.9.6"
russh-cryptovec = "0.7.3"
ssh-encoding = "0.2.0"
ssh-key = { version = "0.6.6", default-features = false, features = ["encryption", "ed25519", "rsa", "getrandom", "ecdsa"] }
thiserror = "1.0.63"
tokio = { version = "1.40.0", features = ["io-util", "macros", "rt"] }
tokio-util = "0.7.11"

| :warning: WARNING           |
|:----------------------------|
| This fork is deprecated and will be made obsolete in the near future. Please continue to report issues, but do not open new Pull Requests.     |

## Bitwarden-russh

Bitwarden-russh is an ssh-agent implementation, based on the russh crate, with everything unnecessary removed.
